Taylor Ng: Morning y'all — I'm Taylor, joining as Platform PM. Day one! Quick Qs: any ETA on the MDM laptop delivery? Also who should I ping about stickers + desk plant request? :seedling: :tada:
Maria Gomez: welcome Taylor!! your laptop is out for delivery (tracking: UPS 1Z999...). I'll DM the sticker catalog and drop a plant on the desk request for you.
Kevin Chu: hey — welcome! for SSH access, ping #eng-infra and include your mac addr if you can. If you want to pre-authorize key, paste your pubkey here or in a DM.
Taylor Ng: thanks Maria + Kevin. putting my pubkey here so infra can add it:
```
ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQC3... taylor@home
```
Harper Simmons: hi Taylor 👋 fun fact: I once did a month-long road trip in a van. two truths & a lie later?
Taylor Ng: love that — two truths/lie: i have a dog named Mochi, i lived in Tokyo for 2 years, i hate coffee.
Maria Gomez: coffee-hater?? :eyes: my money's on Tokyo being true.
Kevin Chu: Mochi is true, I call it. also +1 on grabbing you for the onboarding lunch at 12.
Taylor Ng: Mochi is real, Tokyo is true, I absolutely love coffee ☕ — so the lie is "i hate coffee". thanks everyone for the warm welcome. I'll hop into #eng-infra per Kevin and follow up on stickers with Maria.
OnboarderBot: Welcome message sent to Taylor Ng. Scheduled 1:1 with People Ops (Seth) on 3032190000. New-hire checklist: IT asset assigned, Slack access, benefits portal invite.
Maria Gomez: PS — if you want a standing desk converter, reply here and I'll add it to the order.
Taylor Ng: yes please on the converter, thx!
Kevin Chu: ping me if you run into permission errors, I can help unblock.
Harper Simmons: welcome again — catch you at lunch :ramen:
